interpretation: All three GPU lanes are qualified in one public release; every claim binds an exact package, profile, and receipt.

A managed stop on the RTX 4090 native lane now reaches the server's graceful shutdown: the manager mints a named kernel event per launch, the server (admitting only SYSTEM and Administrators) closes its listener, finishes in-flight requests, saves every live session, and reports what it saved; the lane proves a never-published session survives a managed restart, and the stop receipt records a stop that lost state instead of calling it graceful.

The channel is a per-release capability: the shared controller passes the new flags only to a release whose record declares them, so a rollback to v0.6.0 is stopped by termination as before, and the installer carries the capability through every rewrite of an existing record.
The RTX 5090 and RTX 3090 components carry unchanged from v0.6.0 by hash; the RTX 3090 mainline candidate ships separately when its host returns.
Raw prompts, model outputs, private host identifiers, and raw request logs are excluded.
remaining_release_gates: external-installation acceptance against the published v0.6.1-qwen38-4090-beta.1 component
